Notes: Earliest historical documents mentioning Jews in Lokachi; presence documented without count
Dov Ber (Great Maggid of Mezritch) born in Lokachi; individual Jew documented
Metric book of Jews of Lokachi Volodymyr-Volyn County; earliest births 1859-1863 in State Archive of Volhynia Oblast; organized community
5 synagogues active in Lokachi; Hasidic centre in 19th century
Jews owned the only pharmacy-products warehouse and a medovicular factory; both steam mills; more than 40 shops
German troops seized town 23 June 1941; closed ghetto established October 1941
Ghetto liquidated 13 September 1942: 1350 people including refugees shot over pits (death toll incl. refugees so not town population)
Ghetto liquidated 9 September 1942 by German gendarmerie and Ukrainian police; more than 1500 Jews killed in a grave (death toll)
